title: pilosella × fuscoatra
intro: Pilosella × fuscoatra, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a hybrid species derived from the cross between Pilosella officinarum and Pilosella aurantiaca. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × fuscoatra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. While more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Pilosella × fuscoatra, it may have potential as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
